value.rationale: The discontinuous balanced cusp core is natural in the two radial coordinates of a singular Hartogs domain. Its entire Toeplitz singular spectrum is characterized with arithmetic missing levels. The first two divergent trace terms forget exponent residue while the exact finite part reveals its Dedekind sum, and inversion produces distinct isospectral geometries. This isolates a meaningful arithmetic obstruction to inverse spectral recovery, beyond routine boundedness.
